inlines.v: NEGOTIATION, noun 1. The act of negotiating; the transacting of business in traffick; the treating with another respecting sale or purchase. 2. The transaction of business between nations; the mutual intercourse of governments by their agents, in making treaties and the like; as the negotiations at Ghent.
